title: Provider Registry
description: Registry of available provider templates for the dotagents CLI.

$schema.description: URL reference to this schema definition.

providers.description: Map of provider names to their registry entries.

ProviderEntry.description: Registry entry for a single provider.

path.description: URL path to the provider's provider.toml, relative to the registry base URL.

checksums.description: SHA-256 checksums of each template file, keyed by filename. Used by the CLI for cache invalidation — if a checksum matches the cached copy, the file is not re-downloaded.

additionalProperties.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the file contents.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the provider (e.g. 'Claude Code').

url.description: URL to the provider's documentation or homepage.
